decision_record.title: Accept R97 local predicate-authority machine contract
decision_record.decision: Accept the exact frozen R97 predicate-authority machine contract as the completed local gate governed by R75 and proceed only into a separately bounded local implementation gate that preserves the useful legacy capabilities named by the founder.
rationale: R97 closed the cross-path provenance escape and passed every durable judge role on exact frozen bytes.
The shared provenance gate fails closed across status, review generation, review validation and durable reopening.
Useful legacy machinery must not disappear while the product hierarchy and data architecture are rebuilt.

alternatives.why_rejected: The exact candidate already had deterministic proof and seven-role clearance; the remaining work belongs in the next implementation gate.

alternatives.route: Begin runtime migration without a preservation register
alternatives.why_rejected: A new screen cannot prove that hidden controls, crons, feedback paths and cross-engine behavior survived.

decision_record.dissent: R97 remains same-process local evidence and does not prove restart durability, concurrency, runtime integration, model intelligence, customer comprehension or value.
decision_record.tradeoffs: The next gate must carry a detailed preservation inventory and characterization burden before visible runtime progress. This cost is accepted to prevent accidental capability loss and false authority.
assumptions: The local R97 contract can be integrated behind trusted persistence and transaction boundaries without changing its meaning.
Legacy capabilities can be separated from their old screens and schemas through adapters and characterization tests.

revisit.trigger: A reproducible implementation proof shows that the frozen R97 contract cannot preserve R75 without contradiction, or a named security, authority or human-value assumption is falsified.
revisit.signal_source: Versioned implementation proof, adversarial fixture or independent review linked to the exact candidate
revisit.action_when_fired: Set the project decision to review_due and prepare a bounded keep, supersede or reverse brief without mutating the frozen R97 evidence.

authority_granted: local adapters, fixtures, tests and documentation with no production call
